Created and designed by a collective of designers from around the world. Exclusive & non-exclusive designs. View non-exclusive print collection We feature a separate non-exclusive print & pattern collection for limited end-use purposes. View the collection in-person or virtually. Schedule an appointment We are readily available to show the print collection at your office, showroom or via Zoom. Custom CAD & bespoke print design, development and/or recoloring services available, please send an email to info@go-designstudio.com, kristine@patterncurator.com or fran@patterncurator.com for any inquiries. Disclaimer All artwork shown on all sites are original. Pattern Curator (&/or dba Go Design Studio) and its artists own the copyrights to the work shown until the artwork has been purchased. As you browse through the site, do not to copy or modify the artwork / designs. Once the artwork is purchased, it will be taken down from the site & not available for multiple buyers. These designs may not be reproduced, replicated or used without purchasing the artwork. Please contact info@go-designstudio.com for inquiries. Follow us @go._design._studio Go Design Studio is a print studio directed, curated and owned by PatternCurator. Email Address Sign Up Thank you! ABOUT — GO DESIGN STUDIO Skip to Content Open Menu Close Menu LOG IN 0 0 LOG IN 0 0 Open Menu Close Menu LOG IN About Go Design Studio is a trend-directed and artistically inclined print studio made for industry professionals. We offer original print & pattern designs, created by designers around the world. The studio is a collective of designers whose focus is on designing prints that can bring concepts to life for apparel, interior and social experience related products. Our designers are forward thinking and production-conscious where all of the print and patterns are handcrafted and digitally rendered for an easy transition to manufacture and produce . Go Design Studio is directed and owned by Pattern Curator , a trend and concept studio dedicated as a source of inspiration for color, print and pattern. www.go-designstudio.com @go._design._studio Contact Email Address Sign Up Thank you! Sign up with your email address to receive news and exclusive prints SUBSCRIBE LOG IN ABOUT CONTACT PATTERN CURATOR
